title: Value Proposition Business Banking
full_description:
Value Proposition Manager Business Banking
ING Private Banking is on an ambitious growth journey. As the market leader in the business segment, we see tremendous potential to expand our footprint in Private Banking in Belgium.
To support this growth, we are strengthening our central teams and building a more integrated approach between Business Banking and Private Banking. Our goal is to serve entrepreneurial clients with one consistent story and a unified value proposition that reflects their unique needs.
A strong Private Banking value proposition naturally includes a solid foundation of Investments, but also extends to Financial and Estate Planning, Next Gen advisory, and tailored services in Daily Banking, Insurance, and Lending.
Given the significant potential we see in the business segment, we are looking for a Value Proposition Manager Business Banking to help shape and deliver this integrated offering for business-owning clients.
You’ll join a high-performing team of experts committed to delivering a best-in-class experience for our Private Banking clients with entrepreneurial profiles.
Your Role: Value Proposition Manager Business Banking
You are responsible for creating a compelling and continuously evolving package of products and services for Business Banking clients within Private Banking, considering trends in the Belgian market.
